name: Katsura Kogoro
source:
The Byakko of Earth from the realm of Chōbaku

A samurai who has central role in Chōshū domain. 29 years old
Intellectual and take interest with many things.
Amiable and his playful side always warm his surrounding.
He is skilled with swordmanship but hates conflict.

Character designer : Yomi
